vibe_rationale: Twenty-one years of independent electronic music, visionary art, workshops and wellness in a camping village, with deep community, though one scene and no brands woven in.
fit_notes: Wellness and breathwork already sit in the program, so recovery, sleep or movement sessions would fit a camping crowd, and the figure of about 5,000 is organiser approximate. The festival runs without corporate sponsorship, so a non-sponsor workshop agreed with the organiser is the only realistic route.
